description: Implementation of a random number generator class (DefaultQuicheRandom) using OpenSSL and platform-specific thread-local RNG state, including functions for generating random bytes and uint64 values, with platform-specific thread-local storage handling.

classes.name: DefaultQuicheRandom
classes.description: Concrete implementation of QuicheRandom providing random byte generation using OpenSSL and platform-specific thread-local RNG state.

methods.name: RandBytes
methods.description: Fills provided buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes using OpenSSL's RAND_bytes.

methods.name: RandUint64
methods.description: Returns a random 64-bit unsigned integer using RandBytes.

methods.name: InsecureRandBytes
methods.description: Fills buffer with pseudo-random bytes using the Xoshiro256++ algorithm, suitable for non-cryptographic purposes.

methods.name: InsecureRandUint64
methods.description: Returns a pseudo-random 64-bit unsigned integer using Xoshiro256++.
